extracted_concepts.name: Vector in R^n
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A vector in R^n is an ordered n-tuple v = (v_1, ..., v_n).

extracted_concepts.name: Ordered n-tuple
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An ordered list of n components.

extracted_concepts.name: Span
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The set of all linear combinations of vectors.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear independence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: c_1 v_1 + ... + c_k v_k = 0 implies all c_i = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Zero vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The vector 0 appearing in the independence condition.

extracted_concepts.name: Basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A linearly independent spanning set.

extracted_concepts.name: Dimension
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The number of vectors in any basis.

extracted_concepts.name: Basis Invariance Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Any two bases for a finite-dimensional vector space have the same number of vectors.

extracted_concepts.name: Finite-dimensional vector space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A vector space having a finite basis.

extracted_concepts.name: Vector space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Abstract framework for vectors, linear equations, matrices, and transformations.

extracted_concepts.name: Change of basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Relating coordinates of a vector in two different bases.

extracted_concepts.name: Transition matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: P satisfies [x]_{B'} = P^{-1}[x]_B.

extracted_concepts.name: Coordinate vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: [x]_B denotes coordinates relative to basis B.

extracted_concepts.name: Inverse matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: P^{-1} is used to convert coordinates between bases.

extracted_concepts.name: Rank
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Dimension of column space and row space.

extracted_concepts.name: Nullity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Dimension of null space.

extracted_concepts.name: Column space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The space spanned by the columns of a matrix.

extracted_concepts.name: Row space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The space spanned by the rows of a matrix.

extracted_concepts.name: Null space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The solution space associated with a matrix.

extracted_concepts.name: Rank-Nullity Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: rank(A) + nullity(A) = n.

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rectangular array associated with linear equations and transformations.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equations understood through the vector-space framework.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear transformation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A mapping represented using matrices and vector spaces.
